dimension_assessment.evidence: Weekly workflow and feedback generator create repeatable reports.
dimension_assessment.recommendation: Track four consecutive weekly reports before claiming trend maturity.

dimension_assessment.evidence: AGENTS rules define triggers, but some skills remain proposed.
dimension_assessment.recommendation: Promote only script-backed skills after verification.

dimension_assessment.evidence: Boundaries exist in L1 docs; active workflow does not spawn agents.
dimension_assessment.recommendation: Keep Codex analysis manual until review prompts are stable.

dimension_assessment.evidence: Workflow serializes health then feedback to preserve report causality.
dimension_assessment.recommendation: Parallelize read-only scans only after report dependency graph is explicit.

dimension_assessment.evidence: Markdown and JSON reports are generated together.
dimension_assessment.recommendation: Review report length and stale sections monthly.

dimension_assessment.evidence: Health result feeds structured feedback and Codex improvement process.
dimension_assessment.recommendation: Require human confirmation before editing rules or scripts.

dimension_assessment.evidence: Issues are preserved as machine-readable fields.
dimension_assessment.recommendation: Convert repeated issues into failure cases.

dimension_assessment.evidence: L1 project registry exists; only one pilot is connected.
dimension_assessment.recommendation: Register each new project before it inherits L1 rules.

dimension_assessment.evidence: Audit readiness and no-go boundaries are clear.
dimension_assessment.recommendation: Prioritize evidence unblock work over cosmetic governance changes.

dimension_assessment.evidence: GitHub Actions schedule can run health and feedback reports.
dimension_assessment.recommendation: Keep notification dry-run until webhook secret handling is reviewed.

dimension_assessment.evidence: Workflow, scripts, AGENTS rules, and review packet are connected.
dimension_assessment.recommendation: Use Codex for analysis, not automatic rule mutation.

dimension_assessment.evidence: Reports record compliance boundaries and do not change gates.
dimension_assessment.recommendation: Keep no-go states explicit in pilot records.

improvement_recommendations.action: Review this feedback report and approve any L1 rule or script changes manually.
Preserve project no-go states when evidence remains missing.

codex_improvement_flow.step_1: Health Check generates Markdown and JSON.
codex_improvement_flow.step_2: Feedback generator converts health data into 12D assessment and recommendations.
codex_improvement_flow.step_3: Codex reviews feedback and drafts changes.
codex_improvement_flow.step_4: Human reviewer confirms before L1 rules, scripts, gates, or evidence files are changed.

auto_allowed: Open issues or recommendations in review documents
human_approval_required: Modify production, payment, provider, or secret-bearing configuration
compliance_note: Feedback is advisory. It does not change gate state or project readiness.
